title: FamilyJoin
description: plinth.family_join/1, from api.family_join(p_code) (the app path) and the relative's own WhatsApp "JOIN <code>" (ops.family_join_by_code via api.whatsapp_family_join; API_CONTRACTS §4.11; built by T45a). The join itself is the relative's opt-in. An unknown, used, cancelled or expired code is a neutral not_found, never this payload. Never a phone number.
